name: Affiliated
description: Affiliate/referral tracking framework: detects affiliate links, cookies the visitor, and records clicks, campaigns and attributed conversions as entities.

suggests.drupal/commerce: Required for affiliate_commerce submodule to track commerce order conversions
suggests.drupal/token: Provides token browser for conversion label patterns

project_description: Affiliated is an affiliate/referral tracking framework for Drupal 10.1+/11. A front-end behaviour detects an affiliate query parameter (default ?affiliate=CODE plus an optional affiliate_campaign=CODE), POSTs it to a tracker endpoint, and stores the affiliate id and campaign in browser cookies. When a cookied visitor later performs a trackable action, an affiliate_conversion entity is created and attributed to the referring affiliate account. It ships three content entities (affiliate_campaign, affiliate_click, affiliate_conversion with a config bundle affiliate_conversion_type), a per-user Affiliate Center dashboard at /user/{uid}/affiliate with own-only reporting Views for campaigns, clicks and conversions, an AffiliateManager service, and events/hooks for extending attribution and commission logic. Included submodules attribute conversions to Commerce orders, user registrations and Webform submissions. Rebuilt from the Drupal 7 affiliate_ng concept with a modern entity/event architecture; currently 1.0.0-alpha.
